text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development, serving as a safety net for the entire team. By having another developer examine your code, you can catch bugs early—long before they reach users and become costly to fix. This process also encourages knowledge sharing; team members learn new techniques and understand different parts of the codebase. Moreover, reviews strengthen overall team quality because everyone feels accountable for the final result. They are not about criticism, but about working together to build reliable, maintainable software. When done respectfully, code reviews become a powerful tool for learning and continuous improvement.
